ModMetaData.name: Flavor Text Extended - Français - Pickle tests
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
In-game functional tests for Flavor Text Extended - Français, run by Pickle. Development only: never published.
Eleven features: loading and load order, English isolation, French text and grammar reaching the defs, the settings page and its hidden shortcut (captured, tagged @review), the language of the pass, meal naming without a stove, captures of French meals, unlisted ingredients, a filmed cook and a two-launch restart test. They need the companion steps assembly built from Tests/Pickle/Source against Mod/Assemblies/FlavorTextExtendedFR.dll and Flavor Text's own FlavorText.dll. The English pass has been played; the French pass and the optional-mods pass are pending. See TESTING.md at the repository root for the passes and Tests/Pickle/README.md for what is deliberately left out.
